basis: The chart compares five selected sentinel sites (A-E) on weekly testing volume (thousands) vs. positive cases detected, showing a positive correlation from ~28k/58 cases (Site A) to ~68k/160 cases (Site E). The task context specifies 'Sentinel site subset review' and asks whether this pattern is ready for 'system-level escalation' (network-wide claim) or 'broader review'. A subset of five sites is insufficient evidence to justify a network-wide operational claim without first validating the pattern across a broader population.
option_label: Route for broader population review before advancing a network-wide claim
